1469 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
Subtract 84 days from 1469-01-19:  
First, subtract 19 days → 1469-01-00 is 1468-12-31.  
Remaining days to subtract: 84 - 19 = 65 days.  
Subtract 65 days from 1468-12-31:  
December has 31 days, so back 31 days → 1468-11-30.  
Remaining: 65 - 31 = 34 days.  
November has 30 days, so back 30 days → 1468-10-31.  
Remaining: 34 - 30 = 4 days.  
Back 4 more days → 1468-10-27.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1468-10-27
